summary: Mars Explorer is an interactive web-based Mars exploration platform designed to help users explore and understand the Martian surface. Using NASA satellite and terrain data, the platform provides interactive maps with zooming, navigation, location selection and information about major Martian landmarks, including Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, Gale Crater and Jezero Crater. Developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Leaflet, the project aims to make Mars geographical information more accessible and support scientific learning and future planetary exploration.
